NousResearch/hermes-agent: evals/ holds real quality harnesses (a compaction recall eval with an LLM judge, a browser-use benchmark) plus many HTTP wire/contract probes. Covered call sites map by module import to both kinds; 10 of the 14 covered call sites sit in one large module (agent/auxiliary_client.py) imported by 9 eval files. Coverage is real at module level, not proof that each call site is evaluated.
Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT: Real eval code: copilot/eval (cost/latency, staleness, style suites) and an onboarding transcription WER harness. copilot/eval says its scorers live in a separate repo (Significant-Gravitas/AgentProbe, public). The one covered call site (copilot/optimize_blocks.py) is matched by folder proximity only and is probably not what those evals exercise.
onyx-dot-app/onyx: Braintrust evals in backend/onyx/evals import the full chat pipeline (onyx.chat.process_message), so they reach LLM calls indirectly; the tool follows imports one level and links only source_filter.py (via a connector-filter regression eval).
dyad-sh/dyad: src/__tests__/evals is an LLM-judged tool-use suite run against production system prompts across several models. The evals call the model directly with production prompts and tools, so only 1 product call site links statically. No workflow runs it.
botpress/botpress: packages/zai/e2e/*.test.ts use @botpress/vai LLM assertions (real evals). v0.2 first reported No evals; adding @botpress/vai detection fixed that. The e2e files reach zai.ts through a helper, so coverage stays 0. Also found: a Twilio client.messages.create counted as an Anthropic call (fixed).
paperclipai/paperclip: promptfoo agent evals in evals/promptfoo, an eval engine in packages/paperclip-runner/src/eval, and a weekly/manual workflow that runs evals from paperclipai/paperclip-evals (HTTP 404 publicly). That workflow was first reported as CI gating; v0.2 now requires push/PR triggers. Only 2 SDK call sites: most model work is delegated to external agent CLIs.
CherryHQ/cherry-studio: The only eval file is resources/skills/skill-creator/scripts/run_eval.py, a bundled skill script that evaluates skill triggering, not cherry-studio. Should be No evals.
bytedance/deer-flow: Eval files include evals for shipped skills (skills/public/skill-reviewer/evals), task-continuity experiment evals under docs/experiments, and scripts/eval_*.py, plus the same bundled skill-creator run_eval.py. None import a call-site module.
HKUDS/Vibe-Trading: agent/evals/harness is a deterministic post-run verifier for agent artifact bundles with case files; it reads artifacts rather than importing call-site modules.
zhayujie/CowAgent: tests/trajectory_eval.py and two test_*eval*.py files evaluate agent tool-call trajectories against expected tools and arguments.
ahmedkhaleel2004/gitdiagram: experiments/*/judge.ts are LLM-judge harnesses (e.g. a blind edge check of generated diagrams). The folder name is experiments/, so they are not seen as evals, and 12 of the 19 counted call sites are the judges' own model calls.
QwenLM/qwen-code: docs/evaluation.md publishes SWE-bench Verified scores across seven releases (harness not in the repo); integration-tests include a terminal-bench test and live-model tests; e2e.yml runs post-merge and nightly, not as a merge gate.
open-webui/open-webui: Model traffic is proxied with aiohttp session.request/post to OpenAI-compatible and Ollama endpoints (routers/openai.py), so the scanner finds 0 SDK call sites and gives no verdict. src/lib/apis/evaluations is the product's model-feedback feature, not an eval suite.
langgenius/dify: Only 1 SDK-style call site is visible; dify routes model calls through its own runtime (invoke_llm, defined in api/core/model_manager.py). No eval surface found by a manual search.
ItzCrazyKns/Vane: No eval, judge, golden or benchmark files found.
linshenkx/prompt-optimizer: evaluation/ folders are the product feature that lets users evaluate prompts (v0.1.0 counted 76 of these files as evals). E2E tests replay recorded (VCR) responses.
labring/FastGPT: evaluation/ folders are the product's app-evaluation feature. LLM calls go through an internal wrapper, so only 2 SDK call sites are visible.
AstrBotDevs/AstrBot: Provider tests (e.g. tests/test_anthropic_source.py) import every call-site module but mock the provider; they count only in the unit-test column.
paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx: src/paperless_ai/tests mock the LLM client; unit-test column only.
iOfficeAI/AionUi: v0.2's first broadened .invoke pattern counted 28 Electron IPC calls such as fetchModelList.invoke(); after narrowing, the 5 remaining call sites are real SDK calls. Only startup benchmarks found, no evals.
ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis: evals/agent_trajectory runs a sample against the real agent executor and scores it (it describes itself as a reporter, not a gate). The one covered call site is src/config.py, linked because the eval imports config, not because it evaluates that call; the agent's own LLM calls are reached indirectly.
kortix-ai/suna: apps/white-label/lumen/agent-kit/evals: deterministic scorer with an answer key (extraction, citations, QA, refusal suites) for one white-label app; no import link to the 10 call sites.
Graphify-Labs/graphify: No eval code in the repo; graphify/benchmark.py measures token reduction, not output quality. BENCHMARKS.md reports QA accuracy from a harness that is not in this repository.
